scripts.build: pnpm --filter @capstone/protocol build && pnpm --filter @capstone/api build && pnpm --filter @capstone/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @capstone/protocol build && pnpm --filter @capstone/protocol test && pnpm --filter @capstone/api test && pnpm --filter @capstone/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @capstone/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @capstone/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @capstone/web typecheck
scripts.ci: pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
